## FAQs

Find answers to common questions about MHTC and Malaysia's healthcare sector.

##### What is MHTC?

The Malaysia Healthcare Travel Council is a government-backed organisation dedicated to connecting international patients with accredited hospitals and specialists. We work to make healthcare travel clear, safe, and accessible.

##### How do you verify hospitals?

All hospitals listed on our platform meet strict accreditation standards and undergo regular audits. We verify credentials, outcomes data, and patient safety records to ensure you're choosing a trusted provider.

##### Can journalists access patient stories?

Yes. We maintain a library of patient testimonials and case studies available for media use. All stories are shared with patient consent and follow strict privacy guidelines. Contact our media team for access.

##### What data do you publish?

We publish treatment outcomes, success rates, cost benchmarks, and hospital capabilities across major specialties. All data is independently verified and updated regularly to reflect current performance.

##### How can industry partners engage?

We work with insurers, corporate wellness programs, and healthcare networks. Visit our Corporate & Industry section or contact our team to discuss partnerships, tenders, or collaboration opportunities.
